title: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Ltd. (NSE: STALLION) — Company Dossier
primer: Stallion makes refrigerant gases, sells most of them to a small set of large buyers and imports most of its raw material. FY26 targets were met and net cash is about ₹400 crore after the rights issue, but margins swing within the year (18.2% in June 2026, 2.2% in September 2026) and the R-32 plant has slipped. The price of ₹187.12 already assumes about 20% profit growth for ten years, and the stock is in Stage 4. New capital waits for the ₹155.07 to ₹159.79 support zone, with a ₹152.30 stop and a probability-weighted two-year value of ₹226.9. The call changes if the R-32 plant starts on schedule and the stock repairs its averages, and it is wrong if a weekly close breaks ₹152.30.
holding_rationale: Stallion is not held in any account in the positions ledger, so there is no sale to recommend and no trim or exit to execute. The decision is about new capital only: wait for the support zone to hold on a closing basis, with the stop at ₹152.30 as the level that ends the setup. Cash keeps the next marginal rupee until the zone and the plant evidence line up.

holding_alerts.instruction: Re-run the Stage 2 scan and the evidence checks in this dossier. No order; no shares are affected.

holding_alerts.trigger: Weekly close below the ₹152.30 invalidation level
holding_alerts.instruction: Remove the name from the entry list and close the setup. No order; no shares are affected.

holding_alerts.trigger: Daily close above the 50-day average, on volume above the 30-day average
holding_alerts.instruction: Start a re-test of the trend and review the plant timetable. No order; no shares are affected.

destinations.recommendation: Retain the entire next marginal unit in cash.
destinations.rationale: Stallion is in Stage 4 and about 17 percent above its support zone, and no shortlist or outside name was underwritten in this dossier with a verified entry and downside. Cash keeps the option open without forcing a destination.
destinations.entry_condition: Reallocate only when an equity candidate clears the current evidence, technical and risk/reward gates.

destinations.recommendation: No active-shortlist name is funded from this marginal cash unit in this dossier.
destinations.rationale: Several shortlist names clear today's technical gate, but they have not been underwritten in this report, so none is promoted here.
destinations.entry_condition: Reassess shortlist candidates only with a fresh same-session snapshot, a completed evidence review and a confirmed support setup.

destinations.rationale: No outside equity is promoted without the same filing, price and downside analysis, and no destination is invented to force deployment.
destinations.entry_condition: Fund only after a separate evidence-backed review identifies a candidate with current entry asymmetry.

horizons.rationale: Stage 4 on the company snapshot. Price is below the 10-day, 20-day, 30-week and 10-week averages, weekly RSI is 46 and the 4-hour close is below its 20-period average. No entry passes the no-FOMO gate.
Requires the R-32 plant started by the end of December 2026 and operating margins recovering from the September 2026 level. Both are unproven.
The product has a regulatory runway under the Kigali Amendment. The price assumes profit growth near 20% a year for ten years, and that has not started.

The options step ran with the browser check skipped (options_snapshot.py --no-browser). The live TradingView and Robinhood Chrome review did not run, so the chart and tape reads in chapter 8 come from the stock snapshot and the TradingView technicals page [32], not from a live chart check. Stallion is not in the NSE derivatives segment, so the options package records it as NOT_OPTIONABLE_OR_ILLIQUID and the shelf label describes price structure only.

Most primary records in the research set are older than the 60-day freshness window. The citation check was run with --allow-stale-asof. Current facts rest on the FY26 annual report, the Screener series to September 2026 and the August 2026 earnings call [1][8][14].
The web search tool returned no results for the research queries, so sources were gathered by direct fetches of the company, Screener, TradingView and peer pages.

Several sources returned HTTP 403 on fetch, including Business Standard, BSE, PIB and the Chemours press release. Claims that depended on them are cited to the company's own filings or the SEC filings where those could be reached, and the remaining claims are labelled as unverified where the cause was not found.

The share count of 11.61 crore is implied from the company's market value and price. TradingView shows a market capitalisation of ₹2,285 crore on a different share basis [32]. The valuation uses the implied count and reports the difference in chapter 7.
The Stallion row in the peer snapshot uses TradingView fields that do not match the Screener basis used for valuation, so the peer table is a cross-check and not the valuation basis [14][32].

ch4.gate_intro_prose: The momentum screen tests whether the stock is in a zone where new money can enter without chasing. Under the No-FOMO rule, a buy needs three things at once: the price inside its support zone, the zone holding on a closing basis, and the short-term structure starting to repair. The table applies those tests to the 13 November 2026 close. A stock that fails them is waiting for support, however strong the business story.
